jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT, business, and finance? As a Senior Business Consultant, you will specialize in banking and investment, collaborating with clients and experienced colleagues to design IT solutions and develop expertise in investment processes and corporate actions.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Senior Business Consultant with an interest in digitalization and financial services to support initiatives within banking and investment. You will contribute to analyzing business needs, mapping processes, and designing IT solutions in close collaboration with clients and colleagues.

You will join a team of highly experienced professionals, where you will contribute with your established domain expertise, while continuously expanding your knowledge of IT solutions within banking and investment. As a part of the emerging team in Aarhus, you will become a go-to within banking and investment solutions.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Analyzing clients' business needs and translating and formulating requirements into IT solutions within the banking and investment domain.

• 
Mapping business processes and facilitating workshops with clients to identify needs, challenges, and opportunities for optimization.

• 
Co-leading the analysis and design of solutions related to investment processes.

• 
Collaborating with colleagues and clients on solution design, testing, refinement, and implementation, while supporting user involvement, training, and change management.

• 
Acting as a Subject Matter Expert, leveraging in-depth domain knowledge to drive project outcomes, provide expert guidance, and facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how IT can support and improve them. Deadlines do not intimidate you, and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

Have extensive experience within the banking sector and especially the investment domain, ideally working at the intersection of IT, business, and organization.

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it., or a similar degree with a focus on the intersection of finance and IT.

• 
Have a genuine interest in IT and digitalization, preferably combined with an interest in finance, banking, investment, or financial services.

• 
Have comprehensive experience with investment-related processes. Previous experience within banking or investment is a requirement.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must

jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Scientist - Molecular Innovation and Discovery
jobs.description:
Job title: Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Principal Scientist, you will play a key role in building a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research and contribute to shape how it turns emerging biology into molecular interventions. You will co-create new therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, design the molecules that test them and establish their pharmacological potential. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, molecular pharmacology, peptide chemistry or a related discipline, typically complemented by at least eight years of relevant post-PhD research experience, or equivalent scientific contributions and leadership. Relevant experience may come from academia, biotechnology or the pharmaceutical industry.

• Deep expertise in molecular design and a strong understanding of how molecular properties influence pharmacological activity.

• A record of turning original ideas into experimental tools, therapeutic candidates or discovery projects, evidenced through publications, patents, project progression or other relevant contributions.

• Experience connecting chemistry with biological assays and in vivo findings to guide molecular optimisation.

• The ability to evaluate therapeutic modalities and select approaches suited to the target, mechanism and intended site of action.

• Experience leading scientific work and influencing decisions across multidisciplinary collaborations.

• Creativity, sound scientific judgement and a willingness to pursue unfamiliar approaches while testing assumptions rigorously.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Peptide engineering, peptide–drug conjugates or targeted delivery.

• Multi-receptor pharmacology or approaches combining complementary mechanisms.

• Neuropharmacology, cardiometabolic disease or healthspan research.

• Receptor pharmacology and mechanistic assay development.

• Collaborations connecting molecular design, synthesis and biological evaluation.

You are not expected to bring expertise across every modality or therapeutic area.

**What You Will Do

**You will provide scientific leadership at the interface of molecular design, biology and experimental pharmacology.

• Originate therapeutic concepts that connect biological mechanisms with opportunities for molecular intervention, and design molecular tools and drug candidates to establish pharmacological proof of concept.

• Develop strategies involving peptides, small molecules, conjugates or other modalities, choosing the approach that fits the biological question.

• Guide iterative molecular design using findings from in vitro assays, in vivo pharmacology and relevant DMPK studies.

• Contribute hands-on to experimental research, such as molecular preparation, characterisation or pharmacological evaluation, according to project needs and available capabilities.

• Identify technologies that expand our ability to modulate biological targets or deliver pharmacological activity.

• Assess evidence critically and recommend which concepts to advance, redirect or discontinue.

• Mentor colleagues and communicate molecular strategies, findings and recommendations across disciplines.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will shape the molecular innovation agenda of a new team and contribute to its first generation of discovery projects. The role combines scientific ownership with close involvement in experimental work, using emerging biological findings to guide the development of molecular approaches.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into molecular approaches that can change what we know about cardiometabolic disease and healthspan, apply for the Senior Principal Scientist – Molecular Innovation and Discovery role by 22 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

You will be responsible for your assigned scientific activities, from study design and data interpretation to technical recommendations and reporting. As a subject matter expert (SME), you will also serve as a key scientific contact for clients and internal stakeholders, helping explain process performance, address technical challenges, and recommend practical next steps.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Planning and leading process characterization (PC) studies, including experimental design, data evaluation, and preparation of PC work reports.

• Designing and evaluating down-scale model qualification (DSMQ) studies to demonstrate representativeness of manufacturing-scale processes.

• Applying statistical methods, including Design of Experiments (DoE), and tools such as JMP to support data-driven scientific conclusions.

• Contributing to FMECA and other process risk assessments to identify critical process parameters and support control strategy development.

• Supporting late-stage development activities, including Limit of In Vitro Cell Age (LIVCA) studies, Working Cell Bank (WCB) activities, scale-up, and technology transfer.

• Providing scientific guidance to laboratory technicians, collaborating across functions, and communicating technical findings, project status, and recommendations to clients.

You will also contribute to technical documentation, including development reports, technology transfer documentation, and relevant regulatory submissions.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced scientist with strong technical knowledge of mammalian upstream processes and the ability to translate scientific data into practical recommendations.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Hold a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in biotechnology, biochemical engineering, or another relevant scientific discipline.

• Have at least five years of relevant industry experience with a Master's degree or two years with a PhD, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Have solid experience with mammalian cell culture processes, including bioreactor operations and scale-up.

• Have experience with late-stage process development, such as process characterization, scale-down models, or technology transfer.

• Can design studies, apply statistical methods, interpret complex data, and communicate scientifically sound conclusions.

• Have experience with process risk assessments and preparing clear scientific reports and technical documentation.

• Communicate effectively with clients and cross-functional colleagues and are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with JMP, DoE, AMBR250, DSMQ, FMECA, statistical equivalence testing, process modelling, or regulatory submissions will be an advantage. We recognize that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect you to have experience with every method or technology listed.

You work independently, take responsibility for your commitments, and maintain high standards of scientific quality. You can structure your work and prioritize competing tasks, even when project requirements change.

When challenges arise, you approach them calmly and logically, communicate openly about progress and risks, and involve colleagues or your manager when support is need.

You are comfortable discussing scientific findings with clients, explaining the rationale behind your recommendations, and working with others to resolve challenges. You value mutual respect, open communication, and learning from colleagues.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will work on different client projects, helping prepare mammalian upstream processes for clinical and commercial manufacturing.
